start.headline: Where is every family in your admissions process?
start.body: With Banner Connect, the answer is one screen away.

steps.alt: The pipeline columns with family counts and tuition totals
steps.title: Every stage, from inquiry to enrolled
steps.body: Families move left to right: New Inquiry, Visit Scheduled, Visit Attended, Application Sent and on to enrolled. Each column shows how many families and how much tuition.

steps.alt: A family card showing lead source, tuition value and days since last contact
steps.title: Every family has a card
steps.body: See where they came from, what they're worth in tuition and how many days since your last contact. Cards tagged Cold need attention.

steps.alt: The task list with overdue follow-ups assigned to the admissions director
steps.title: And a to-do list that keeps up
steps.body: Follow-ups are assigned to a person with a due date. Overdue calls turn red so they get handled first.

finish.headline: No more spreadsheets or sticky notes.
finish.body: Everyone on your team sees the same picture of every family.
